title: The Oath of Ironhollow
author: Sable Galloway
blurb: Oscar Eriksen, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
